lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately 6-8 visible vertical columns. The spatial distribution shows a higher density of smaller clusters in the cephalic region, transitioning to larger, more discrete nodes along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular spots, creating a grid-like appearance where the spots act as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with a high-luminance top edge and a localized shadow region directly below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface is characterized by a high-density distribution of small high-luminance blobs that diminish in size and frequency toward the trailing edge and distal tip.
